method: Every compressed blob and every expanded diff_id verified. License files collected from all layers. Final package state parsed from final dpkg/status, with Source/Version treated as scalar fields and symlink/same-source copyright resolution. Earlier layer files remain distribution material even if later whiteouts remove them.
limits: This inventory covers the pinned image identities listed in images.
For task-specific or rebuilt images derived from this base, inventory added or changed layers and retain their component-specific notices and source materials.
Include each component's license text, notices and corresponding source or source-access materials required by its terms with any distributed image.
